K9 Gym and Rehabilitation Center is dedicated to enhance your pet's quality of life & comfort.  Our compassionate staff is comprised of veterinarians, veterinary technicians, a physical therapist, & a massage therapist who are certified in veterinary acupuncture & chiropractic, canine rehabilitation, &/or massage. After your pet is evaluated by our veterinarian & physical therapist, we will create a custom tailored treatment program to restore mobility & minimize your pet's discomfort through the various services we provide.

K9 Gym and Rehab offers veterinary acupuncture & chiropractic (musculoskeletal manipulation) services, therapeutic massage, cold laser therapy, ultrasound therapy, electrical stimulation, therapeutic exercise, and hydrotherapy using underwater treadmills and a 15,000 gallon pool.  

Whether your pet is a performance athlete or a laid-back senior, we at K9 Gym and Rehab are dedicated to improving their comfort & quality of life.
